digest.component_or_area: CLI command structure and bridge subcommands
propositions: Three CLI verbs are being renamed: bridge-fsck→bridge fsck, bridge-probe→bridge check-access, jira-onboard→bridge setup, with the old spellings retained as functional compatibility entrypoints.
The new noun-based spellings become canonical in all help text, documentation, scripts, workflows, and examples while maintaining identical parser and implementation paths as legacy spellings.
All enumerated in-tree consumers (CLI dispatch, help files, schemas, scripts, tests, and documentation) must be migrated to the new spellings in the same atomic change.

The bridge setup command must maintain pass-through dispatch to the onboarding wizard, preserve all existing options (--no-validate, --reset, --yes, --url/--user/--project), and call bridge check-access as its final validation step with environment overlay support.

Behavioral parity tests must prove the old and new spellings produce identical output, exit status, and behavior across success, representative failure, options/arguments, and output schema scenarios.

String-named test sites (monkeypatch.setattr calls and literal command assertions) and all stale vocabulary references must be migrated or explicitly categorized as compatibility/history through allowlist entries.
